name: check
wording: A deterministic test that runs on every change before it joins: one binding an example, or one of the project's own tests. A check binding an example binds that example's meaning and nothing it did not fix: each assertion names the example's words it binds, a failing case exists only where those words call for one, and it reads nothing from the operator's host the example does not name. It is adequate when it rejects the plausible failures its example names. Where a capability already defines correctness, the check delegates to it. An agent's behaviour is never checked; it is judged in use.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
